title: Handcrafted Grammar for Every Artifact
description: Move from one generic dsl/protocol grammar to handcrafted document-specific grammars for every app/artifact: all ~53 document grammars, ~34 config grammars, ~53 op-line grammars, plus embedded languages (jack, construct, expr, md). Graph-like data reads over arrows (a@port -e1:Connection> b@port {props}), reusing shared family grammar kits designed consistently. Every grammar ships a hand-authored .grammar spec file with a repo-wide conformance sweep, gets service from one shared LSP host, and is opened live in the writer with real diagnostics/completion/highlighting. Full architecture + execution program at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/pack-spr-and-dsl-op-are-functional-kettle.md. Supersedes and absorbs the remaining W4-W6 scope of the closed ticket 26/07/31/DOMAIN-TRUE-NOTATION-FOR-EVERY-DSL-SUPERSEDED (its W0-W2 engine spine + fem2d/note pilots carry forward as the semantic-model layer this program builds notation on top of).
summary: Domain-driven handcrafted grammars/protocols: protocol AST+walker, Recognizer FragmentRegistry/BOOL, family kits, P3 policies+M5 sweep, pilots+W5 fan-out, P6 derive codec emission removed, allowlists empty (0 handcrafted policy breaches). Full cargo/semio/OS UI e2e blocked on host by Xcode SDK license.
